profile.headline: Sr Software Developer at Rady Children’s Institute for Genomic Medicine
profile.summary: Specialties: Certified Scrum Master and Master in Information Technologies

company.name: Rady Children's Institute for Genomic Medicine

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
Software engineer with 20+ years of experience designing and deploying full-stack applications, especially in the healthcare industry.

Leading developers, planning projects, assigning tasks, coordinating infrastructure upgrades, and ensuring secure, scalable deployments. I specialize in Python, Flask, Django, React, and SQLAlchemy, with strong backend experience in REST APIs, Celery, RabbitMQ, and Redis. Creating AWS lambda functions to create integrations with different systems like internal Portal and Fabric.

Designed and implemented JellyBot, an AI-powered genomic data platform integrating AWS Bedrock, Bedrock Guardrails, Aurora PostgreSQL/RDS, and Python-based ETL pipelines to securely synchronize clinical data and enable natural language querying through RAG-enabled and DB agents.

Understanding of HIPAA, CAP, CLIA, and Infosec compliance, and was responsible for identifying and resolving vulnerabilities during external penetration tests.

Developed and supported the JellyBot ETL pipeline responsible for aggregating and transforming data from multiple sources including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB into AWS RDS environments to support AI-driven initiatives and Bedrock-enabled applications

Passionate about building tools that solve real problems — especially in high-impact environments like healthcare.

positions.description: Skills: Capacidad de análisis · Ciencias de la computación · jQuery · FlaskRestful · MySQL · Docker Products · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Flask · Data caching · Full-Stack Development · Flask-SQLAlchemy · React.js · Microservices · Python (Programming Language) · Product Requirements · Selenium · JavaScript · Inglés

positions.title: Sr Python Developer
positions.description:
Developed RESTful web services using Django REST Framework, with a primary focus on a dashboard application for monitoring various services and applications.

Implemented Views, Models, and Serializers in Django; the front-end interface was developed using Node.js and Angular.

Designed and integrated Django signals to handle event-driven status updates from multiple applications.

Utilized SAML and JWT (JSON Web Token) protocols for secure authentication of requests via Okta.

Created comprehensive unit tests to ensure the reliability and correctness of API endpoints.

Applied Django migrations to modify and maintain the database schema as project requirements evolved.
Addressed and reduced Sonar Qube issues to enhance overall code quality and maintainability.

Developed Python scripts for database operations, including truncating tables and importing VLAN ranges.

Adhered to PEP 8 coding standards to maintain code readability and consistency.

Optimized API endpoint performance to ensure faster and more efficient data retrieval.
positions.insights: Skills: Capacidad de análisis · Ciencias de la computación · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Microservices · Resolución de problemas · Product Requirements · Inglés

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Nueva York y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
•	Web implementation for different web sites (landing pages) with Flask and Python
•	Implementing admin sites to manage database information with FlaskAdmin, MySQL and SQLite.
•	Python scripting implementation for processing database records.
•	Extensive experience doing backend development using Python 
•	Nodejs for implementing restful web services
•	Develop all the backend implementation for new connections with carriers; this includes publishing and consuming restful web services with CherryPi.
•	Implementing queues with RabbitMQ to manage the billing in our services, this help us to avoid losing transactions and have a better performance in our platform, once the queue was created a processor implemented in Python was implemented.
•	Source control tools like GIT (Github,) SVN and Jenkins.
•	Front End Development when it was needed using HTML5, HTML4 with responsive designs and adaptive for mobile.
•	Backend Development, generation of administration panels, and catalog administration with Silex.

positions.title: IT Leader
positions.description:
•Implementing and designing new projects based on messaging (SMS), these projects were developed in Java (J2EE).
•Project Planning, Arrange of the customer project management tool, with times, deadlines and effort that would be required for each iteration, running on Agile methodologies like SCRUM and Kanban.
•Adapting new J2EE core classes to local regions for launching new projects.
•Configuration of new services in Oracle DB when it was needed.
•Implementation of architecture, flow, statistics report for the VOICE TV show, this project consisted in receive all the SMS for the audience to vote for their favorite singer. While the show was live I was in charge of monitoring that our platform was up and running correctly.
•Design patterns adaptation in implementations like service locator.
•Software Engineering, using tools for coding, manuals and standards documents, using a progressive development (bottom-up), seeking for deliverables MVP (Most Viable Product), and the preparation for major versions.
•Q&A Trough Requirements, Customer Histories, Use Cases & Wireframes

projects.title: RAG Document Questions and Answers System
projects.description:
RAG Document Assistant | FastAPI · LangChain · Qdrant · Docker · Python

Built a local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that answers natural language questions using your own documents. Ingested and chunked documents, generated embeddings, and stored them in a Qdrant vector database with metadata (source file, chunk index, page number) for precise retrieval. 
Exposed the pipeline via a FastAPI REST API, containerized with Docker for portability. Integrated LangChain to orchestrate retrieval and LLM response generation.
